name: The Suspended Waterfall Library
description: A library built into a cascading waterfall, with shelves carved into stone, books floating on the water currents, and light refracting through mist.
prompt: A Suspended Waterfall Library: stone shelves carved into the side of a cascading waterfall, floating books drifting on water streams, mist diffusing golden sunlight, reflections on water, photorealistic, magical realism.
caption: Read where the water reads too—the Suspended Waterfall Library whispers stories in every droplet 💧📚.
